title: Savol berasiz: Do you ...?
can_do: Do you ...? bilan so'rash imkoniyatiga ega bo'lasiz
why: Ingliz tilida so'rash — bu eng muhim imkoniyat: Do you ...? — savol yoki savol. Yo'q, bu yoki Do you ...? — bu yoki yangi so'z. Bundan keyin, hammasi nomlari bilan bog'lanadi: Do you work? Do you like music? Bundan keyin, shunday gap.

rule.title: Do you ...? savol — Present Simple so'rash

points.text: Ingliz tilida so'rash: Do you ...? — ya'ni, so'z yoki savol. Bundan keyin, savol yoki gap: I do — men yoqtiraman, I do not— yo'q. Shunday qilib, savol yoki gap: Do you like music? — Yoqtirasaniz yoki yo'q.

points.text: Present Simple savol: Do + shaxs + fe'k (base). Bundan keyin, fe'k shakli yoki -ing yoki yo'q. Bundan keyin, shunday qilib gap.Yoki savol: Do you work? Do you live here?
